info.submission: Fixed a KeyError crash in cell 3 where the code attempted to drop columns that don't exist in the test dataframe. Modified the drop operation to only attempt dropping columns that are actually present in the dataframe by filtering the column list with a list comprehension. This prevents the crash while maintaining the original intent of removing specified columns if they exist.
